stages.label: S1-Prelim
stages.description: Preliminaries — density matrices, fidelity, tensor products, symmetric subspace, Schur-Weyl duality, Young diagrams, Specht/Weyl modules, Schur transform, Jucys-Murphy elements, SoS(d) cone

stages.label: S2-Purification
stages.description: The random purification channel (acorn trick) — construction of Phi^{d,r}, Schur basis decomposition, random purification formula, proof of Theorem 1.1

stages.label: S3-PureTomo
stages.description: Efficient pure state tomography — approximate unitary t-designs, moment bounds (Lemma 4.1), concentration (Lemma 4.2), covering net argument, proof of Theorem 1.2

stages.label: S4-MixedTomo
stages.description: Efficient mixed state tomography — combining purification channel with pure state tomography via Uhlmann's theorem, proof of Theorem 1.3

stages.label: S5-GPSPure
stages.description: GPS moment analysis (pure state) — moment operator definition, Hayashi's algorithm, first/second moment operators (Lemmas 5.2-5.3), GPS moments (Theorem 1.4)

stages.label: S6-GPSMixed
stages.description: GPS moment analysis (mixed state) — Mix(GPS) moments (Theorem 1.5), Mix+(GPS) moments (Theorem 1.6), partial trace helper (Lemma 6.1)

stages.label: S7-PGM
stages.description: Pretty good measurement interpretation — Hilbert-Schmidt measure, PGM equivalence (Proposition A.1), conditional PGM for Mix+(GPS) (Corollary A.1)

stages.label: S8-Applications
stages.description: Applications — limited-entanglement tomography, shadow tomography, quantum metrology
